notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE RELEASED!
notes.content:
Great news for anyone that loves new content that tests their
 rogue-ish skills under increasingly demanding conditions: We've gone
 ahead and added the brand new SURVIVAL mode to Rogue Contracts:
 Syndicate as a free post-launch update!
 
 Battle an increasing number of enemy agents while perfecting your
 lethal skills, and learn how to fully take advantage of a
 color-changing mansion's layout in RC:S's latest mode. Set up
 ambushes, survive impossible odds relying on stealth, and know that
 only the very best -- the elite -- can survive the gauntlet.
 
The time to challenge your friends (and, possibly, enemies) has come!
 

- Go Dark Team
